title: HOW TO #11: Build a Boat To Cross a Waterfall
caption:
How to build a boat that crosses a waterfall 🚣‍♂️🌊

A 30 meter waterfall and a boat made of 4 barrels. 10 problems, 10 fixes: planks on top, a heavy keel, 2 oars, a rudder for the rapids, a ramp at the edge, a safety harness, a cover against splashes, tires on the front, 4 more barrels. A boat that survives a 30 meter drop and lands dry.

Would you ride it first or send a dummy? Comment DROP below. Tag the friend who says just try it. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #12!
